_meta.method: Claude Code research agent (general-purpose) — multi-network web crawl across Sotoshu Europe, Boeddhistische Unie Nederland (BUN), Lotus Zen Centra Nederland, Maha Karuna Ch'an local groups, Leven in Aandacht (Plum Village NL), Kanzeon Sangha (Big Mind), Zen Deshimaru / AZI, and individual center websites.
_meta.coverageEstimate: ~60-70% of an estimated 80-120 active Zen practice places in the Netherlands. Strong coverage of named temples/centers and Plum Village sangha network; Zen.nl franchises sampled (chain has 40+ city locations, only flagship listed). Single-teacher home zendos likely undercounted.
knownGaps: Zen.nl Nederland operates 40+ local franchises (Rinzai-inspired Ritskes school) — only the Nijmegen HQ is listed; per-city addresses not consolidated.
Kanzeon Sangha has additional small affiliate groups (e.g., Stefan Coppens' Berlicum group) with limited public web presence.
Sanbō Zen had no confirmed standalone NL zendo at search time (NL practitioners typically travel to Sanbo Zendo Germany).
Kwan Um School of Zen has no confirmed standalone NL center (closest are Belgium and Germany).
AZI (Deshimaru) NL dojo directory page returned 404; only the European Zen Center / Zen Dojo Amsterdam (Kosen line) confirmed.
Maha Karuna Ch'an additional sit groups in BE listed on the same page were excluded as out-of-country.
